proc.name: Offender Proceedings (Police Stations) - policedata.nz Tableau Public workbook
proc.licence: No licence stated on policedata.nz or the Tableau Public workbooks. The NZ Police website copyright page (https://www.police.govt.nz/about-site-and-nz-police-app/copyright, copy in raw/police_govt_nz_copyright.html) states: 'You may save to disk and reprint images and other information contained on this site for non-commercial private purposes only. Requests and enquiries concerning the reproduction of information on this website ... for any other purpose requires permission. Manipulation or alteration in any way of images or information on this site is prohibited without the written permission from the copyright owner.' (A CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 licence on that page applies only to Police Manual chapters.) Tableau Public lists the workbooks with 'allowDataAccess: true' (data download enabled). Treat re-use on a public map as needing NZ Police permission or at least clear attribution; check before publishing.
proc.notes: Counts are OFFENDER PROCEEDINGS (offenders dealt with by Police, by court action or otherwise) for ANZSOC Division 'Homicide' - NOT counts of homicide victims or incidents. Each ANZSOC group is its own measure: Murder, Attempted murder, Manslaughter, Driving causing death. Read directly from the workbook's Hyper extracts (raw/OffenderProceedingsPoliceStations.twbx) with tableauhyperapi, filtered to ANZSOC_DIVISION='Homicide'. The extract stores one row per combination of attributes; I summed PROCEEDINGS to each geography x month x ANZSOC group, giving a Total and one-way breakdowns by weapon, method of proceeding (division/subdivision/group), location type, offender age group, offender ethnicity and person/organisation (from extract A_E_G), and relationship of offender to victim (from extract E_R_G, which holds the same totals). The four extracts in the workbook give identical homicide totals (Murder 923, Attempted murder 185, Manslaughter 310, Driving causing death 1091 over the whole period); every level and every breakdown sums back to these. Police station area_id is 'District|Area|Station'. Territorial authorities are matched by name to geoBoundaries ADM2 (Stats NZ 2021); 'Auckland.' (Auckland Council) is matched to the ADM1 Auckland Region feature because geoBoundaries ADM2 splits Auckland into local board areas; 'Wanganui District.' matched to Whanganui District. No sex breakdown is in the extract. Year column is YYYY-MM as the source gives months.

daily.notes: Counts of recorded occurrences (by date occurred) for ANZSOC division 'Homicide and Related Offences', by ANZSOC group (Murder, Attempted Murder, Manslaughter, Driving Causing Death, Homicide and Related Offences not further defined). Rows with the same date/area/group were summed. The workbook does not define 'Auckland Area' boundaries, so no shape is attached. Days with no occurrence are absent, not zero.
